title: A Volcano Blasted Ash 57 Kilometres Into the Sky

scenes.text: One volcano blasted a plume 57 kilometres into the sky.
In January 2022, the Hunga Tonga volcano erupted in the Pacific.
The plume climbed about 35 miles up, into the mesosphere.
It was the first eruption ever recorded to reach that layer.
The old record, from 1991, was beaten by more than 22 kilometres.
Nothing erupting from Earth has ever been recorded higher.

description:
The 2022 Hunga Tonga eruption sent a plume about 57 kilometres high, the highest ever recorded.
It beat the 1991 record by more than 22 kilometres and reached the mesosphere.
What's the biggest natural event you've ever seen?
